generalAbilities.name: Mist Vision
generalAbilities.description: The fogfisher ignores the Concealed condition from fog and mist.

defensiveAbilities.name: Fog Rupture
defensiveAbilities.description: If a fogfisher takes damage from a critical hit, it must succeed at a DC 16 Flat or the sac that produces its fog aura ruptures. This causes its fog aura to dissipate at the start of the fogfisher's next turn. The fogfisher is then Slowed 1 for 24 hours, after which it recovers and produces its fog aura again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drifting Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 10 minutes

Stage 1 the creature becomes buoyant in the air and is treated as a Tiny creature for the purposes of wind effects and being pulled by the fogfisher's harpoon; if the creature falls, it drifts gently to the ground (1 round)

Stage 2 as stage 1 plus Enfeebled 1 (1 minute)

offensiveAbilities.name: Fog Aura
offensiveAbilities.description: 15 feet. The fogfisher constantly exudes an aura of fog. All creatures within the aura become Concealed, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reel In
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The fogfisher has a Tiny creature Grabbed with its harpoon

Effect The fogfisher retracts its harpoon, pulling the grabbed creature toward it. The grabbed creature must attempt a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The fogfisher fails to move the creature.

Success The fogfisher pulls the creature 5 feet closer.

Failure The fogfisher pulls the creature up to 30 feet closer.

Critical Failure The fogfisher pulls the creature to an adjacent space.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rip Out
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The fogfisher has a creature Grabbed with its harpoon

Effect The fogfisher rips free its harpoon, retracting the spike and leaving a bloody hole behind. The grabbed creature is no longer grabbed and takes 3d6 Persistent,bleed Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save).
